body.x: SEOUL, Korea (AVING) -- <Visual News> Soundgraph expects to display ''Front View'', its supplementary display device at the upcoming CES 2007, which enables to use a pc as consumer electronics in connection with existing media center pc or pc case.
You can check the weather update or the latest news through the touch-screen display mounted on the front without turning on TV as well as control multimedia system.

Dongkwan Jeong, CEO of the company said that while IT giants like MS and Intel have been trying hard to move a pc to the living room, Soundgraph has been focusing on developing convenient pc interfaces from hardware to driver, firmware, and to applications based on its independent technological competitiveness.
